diagnosticsEmptyMessage: iOS delivers reports about once a day when there is something to report.
diagnosticsEmptyMessageAndroid: Reports appear here after qiqstr crashes or stops responding.
diagnosticsFooter: iOS collects crash and performance reports for qiqstr on this device. They stay here and are never uploaded. To help fix a problem, share a report and attach it to a support request. Reports hold technical details about the app, not your posts, messages or keys.
diagnosticsFooterAndroid: qiqstr records crashes and freezes on this device. Reports stay here and are never uploaded. To help fix a problem, share a report and attach it to a support request. Reports hold technical details about the app, not your posts, messages or keys.
emojiNoPacksHere: Add a pack from Discover below to use custom emoji in posts and reactions.
emojiPacksFooter: Custom emoji from these packs appear in the emoji picker for posts and reactions. Your list is saved to your relays.
keysAuthenticateReason: Authenticate to view your private keys
keysBackupAuthenticateReason: Authenticate to create an encrypted backup of your key
keysBackupFooter: An encrypted backup (ncryptsec) is safer to store than your raw nsec because it is useless without your password. It works in other clients that support NIP-49.
keysBackupPasswordFooter: Use at least {count} characters. You need this password to restore your account, and it cannot be recovered if you forget it.
keysBackupQRCode: QR code of the encrypted backup
keysBackupResultFooter: Keep this backup and your password in separate places. Anyone with both can sign in as you.
launchResetCache: Clear cache and relays, then retry
listNotFoundMessage: No relay returned your {list}. If you made one in another app, starting a new list here will replace it.
localNotifyAllowFooter: qiqstr checks for new activity on your device and shows notifications without a push server.
localNotifyDeliveryFooter: Delivery depends on iOS background app refresh. iOS decides when qiqstr can check, usually a few times an hour to a few times a day based on how often you use the app, so notifications can arrive late.
localNotifyDeliveryFooterAndroid: qiqstr checks for new activity in the background about every 15 minutes. Android may delay these checks to save battery, so notifications can arrive late.
localNotifyDeniedFooter: Notifications are turned off for qiqstr in iOS Settings.
localNotifyDeniedFooterAndroid: Notifications are turned off for qiqstr in Android settings.
localNotifyOnlyKnownFooter: Hides notifications from people outside your network. This also filters the notifications list.
localNotifyPromptMessage: Get notified about replies, reactions, zaps and messages. qiqstr checks in the background on your device, so nothing is shared with a push server.
notificationsOnlyKnown: Only from people you may know
relayPublishReplaceMessage: Your relay list on the network differs from this device: {added} would be added and {removed} removed. Other apps that use your list will see the change. Tap Fetch first to start from your published list.
safetyNetworkFooter: Built from the follow lists of up to 1,000 people you follow. It refreshes every 6 hours.
safetySensitiveFooter: Shows posts marked as sensitive without blurring them.
safetySpamFilterFooter: Hides notifications and replies from people outside your network. Your network is you, the people you follow, and people followed by at least {count} of them.
settingsBroadcastMany: Would you like to broadcast all your events to these {count} new relays?
settingsBroadcastOne: Would you like to broadcast all your events to this new relay?
settingsDataSaverFooter: Videos autoplay without sound. With data saver on, photos, videos and link previews load only when you tap them while you're on mobile data.
settingsDeleteAccountFooter: Deleting your account asks relays to remove your data and erases it from this device.
settingsExpandedNotesFooter: Expanded notes use a full-width layout with the content below the author.
settingsGossipDetail: Up to {relays} outbox relays, minimum frequency {frequency}
settingsGossipRestart: Gossip mode changed. Restart the app to apply.
settingsMediaServerFooter: Photos, videos and voice messages you attach are uploaded to this Blossom server. Your choice is published to your relays so other apps can use it too.
settingsMediaServerInvalid: Enter a valid https server address.
settingsNoMutedHashtagsMessage: Posts with a muted hashtag are hidden from your feeds.
settingsNoMutedThreadsMessage: Mute a conversation from a post's menu to hide it and stop its notifications.
settingsSmartCleanupFooter: Removes reactions, reposts, zaps, notes and articles older than 7 days, plus contact lists of people you don't follow. Your profile and lists are kept.
settingsVanishFooter: Sends a deletion request for every event you published and a NIP-62 request to vanish to all your relays, then erases this account’s keys, messages, wallet connection and other data from this device.
settingsVanishTypeToConfirm: This cannot be undone. Type {word} to confirm.
settingsWalletManage: Open your wallet to connect, send and receive
settingsWipeConfirm: All cached events on this device will be deleted and downloaded again from relays. Your keys and settings are kept.
settingsWipeFooter: Deletes every cached event on this device. Data is fetched again from your relays.
